patterns.message: Import from '@/lib/booking' instead. A feature's internals are private — that is what stops a change inside booking breaking services. See ARCHITECTURE.md.
Import from '@/lib/payments'. The individual gateway adapters are private — a caller that reaches esewa.ts directly is a second place that knows which gateway is in play. See ARCHITECTURE.md.
Import from '@/lib/auth' (isomorphic), '@/lib/auth/session' (server) or '@/lib/auth/otp' (client). Everything else under lib/auth is private. See ARCHITECTURE.md.
Import Link from '@/i18n/navigation'. One stray next/link drops a Nepali reader back into English and nothing fails.

paths.name: next/navigation
paths.message: Import redirect, useRouter and usePathname from '@/i18n/navigation' — the next/navigation versions drop the locale. notFound and useSearchParams are fine from here.
